newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.077 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.077 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended October 19 was 4,077,486 gallons compared with 4,275,039 gallons last week.
Imports were 439,602 gallons compared with 308,002 gallons the previous week, and domestic receipts totaled 73,228 gallons versus 167,699 gallons a week ago.
Retail movement was 839,352 gallons compared with 1,026,258 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 3,031,830 gallons versus 3,689,187 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 245,340,084 versus 242,417,764 a year ago.
Inventory was 53,644,337 versus 66,822,580 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
